Software development partner for Ethiopian businesses and international teams

Arada Tech is a product-minded engineering studio in Addis Ababa. We replace manual workflows, spreadsheets, and legacy tools with websites, web applications, mobile apps, and custom software that your team can run every day.

Our projects span healthcare, finance, real estate operations, clearing and document services, and professional services firms. Discovery starts with mapping users, approvals, integrations, and reporting expectations, then design and delivery follow with staging environments, QA, documentation, and post-launch support so operations stay predictable.

If you are headquartered in Ethiopia or collaborating with teams abroad, we can structure milestones, integrations, and hosting to match procurement, compliance, and performance needs. Start with a free consultation or browse the portfolio for similar systems.
